the wind-react procedure is more suitable for the fabrication of coils and magnets.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the quench propagation in the Bi(Pb)-2212/Ag composite tape is not as fast as in the Bi(PB)-2223/ Ag tapes and that the quench propagates more rapidly along the tape width rather than the tape length.
